retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white composition featuring a seated figure in a suit, a mask on a pillow, and ultra-thin geometric sans-serif typography at the top edge.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark black and white scene depicting a man in a suit sitting on a bed, looking down at a theatrical mask resting on a striped pillow. The lighting is directional, creating deep shadows against a plain wall where boxing gloves hang. The top of the frame is occupied by wide-tracked, hairline-weight sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally but weighted toward the bottom half
High contrast between the bright bedsheets and the dark background wall
Textual balance between two distinct phrases at the top corners
Symbolic interaction between the human figure and the inanimate mask
coreInvariants: Directional lighting from the left creating a hard shadow on the right wall

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main figure is seated centrally in the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to appear intimate yet grounded.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white striped pillow and mask serve as the primary high-contrast focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, moves down to the figure's face, follows his gaze to the mask, and then rests on the dark boxing gloves in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant empty wall space above the figure provides room for the display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black shadows and background tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white highlights on the bed and text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the suit texture and wall gradient
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both header elements to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and 70s aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and thin strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white photograph of a man in a 1970s style suit sitting on a bed with striped sheets. He is looking down at a white theatrical mask on a pillow. A pair of boxing gloves hangs on the wall behind him. Use dramatic side lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two phrases in uppercase, hairline-weight geometric sans-serif at the top. Place one phrase in the top left and the other in the top right, ensuring wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the font weight extremely thin?
Is the text placed at the very top edge?
Does the lighting create a distinct shadow on the wall?

postGenerationChecks: Check for true black and white levels
Verify text legibility despite thin weight
